question.text: Dividend Distribution Tax (DDT) under Section 115-O has been:

answer.text: Withdrawn by Finance Act 2020; dividend income now taxed in the hands of investors

explanation.text: The Logic: Per Section 9.3.2, DDT was withdrawn by Finance Act 2020 from April 1, 2020. Dividend income is now taxable in investors' hands. The Trap: Other answers don't reflect the current regime. Cross-Exam Context: Same post-2020 regime applies across MF and AIFs. Distributor's Pro-Tip: Factor investor-level dividend tax into net-return projections.
